scenario: [RARC.5.2.7] with [LEXP.4.2]: the slot refuses NaN and nothing wider -- an infinity a rule emits into a Float slot enters. The same input as `RARC.5.2.7.nan_into_float_slot_is_a_type_error`: the host asserts `Reading.a` = inf, and `r` emits `x.a + 1.0`, which is inf, into the Float slot `Out.v`. `got` logs the fact that entered; `handler` would log a TypeError on `Out.v`. Exactly ["later", "entered inf"]: a NaN check written as a non-finite check refuses the fact and logs `handler`'s line instead. Path: libds rete/engine.c eval_actions (ds_rete_slot_refused admits it, then ds_rete_wm_assert), Mercury ds.exec.m assert_verb (ds.fact.slot_fault finds nothing).
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    a: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule r:
    Reading x
->
    emit Out logical id: x.id v: (x.a + 1.0)

rule later:
    Reading
->
    log info "later"

rule got:
    Out o
->
    log info "entered {o.v}"

rule handler:
    TypeError e where e.schema == "Out" and e.slot == "v"
->
    log info "refused Out.v {e.actual}"
